tables.name: Shipments
tables.grain: one row per shipment; shipped_units at shipment grain

tables.name: Scans
tables.grain: one row per scan; many scans may belong to one shipment

tables.name: ShipmentStatus
tables.grain: one row per shipment per status_date; completion_ratio is daily snapshot

measures.name: shipped_units
measures.basis: Scans may repeat a shipment during the one-to-many join; no deduplication rule is supplied.

measures.name: completion_ratio
measures.basis: Scans can repeat shipment-status rows, and the two-day filter crosses non-additive daily snapshots without a selection rule.

sequence: Join Shipments to Scans on shipment_id.
risks: Arrival scans can duplicate shipment and status rows.
Completion ratios cannot be summed across dates.
alternatives: Conditional: form a distinct shipment_id set having an arrival scan, then aggregate Shipments.
Conditional: choose an approved status snapshot per shipment before aggregating; the rule is not supplied.
